1f797c4832edd2005abaa9076ccc40d3f16bccde.summary: The US Treasury's OFAC sanctioned three North Korean state-sponsored hacking groups (Lazarus Group, Bluenoroff, Andariel), designated as controlled entities of the Government of North Korea through the Reconnaissance General Bureau. The report links Lazarus Group to the WannaCry 2.0 ransomware attack (attributed in December 2017) and the 2014 Sony Pictures attacks. Bluenoroff is tied to bank heists, including an attempted $851 million SWIFT theft, and the groups are said to have stolen cryptocurrency from exchanges.
